//: Which web apps must start cleanly in tools/test-apps.cjs. status: works | broken; phone/tablet override per form factor. note says what is limited. tools/smoke-apps.cjs exercises each app.

com.palm.app.calculator.note: Phone: the TouchPad calculator body fills the card (compat CSS)

com.palm.app.notes.note: Phone: one memo per row; the editor's back button shows its arrow only; the wall's title bar fits any width (the count goes under 400 px)

com.palm.app.accounts.note: The released templates (HP webOS profile, email) and Phoenix CardDAV & CalDAV (apps/dav), which signs in and syncs against a real server (tools/test-dav-sync.cjs). Email accounts cannot be signed in: no mail servers to validate against

com.palm.app.calendar.note: Local (profile) calendar only; no sync or reminders service. Phone: smaller headings and toolbar, one-letter weekdays in month view

com.palm.app.clock.note: Phone: clock faces scaled to fit. Alarms ring through the simulated activity manager (tools/test-alarm.cjs)

com.palm.app.contacts.note: Phone: list and details one at a time (back gesture returns). No automatic linking of similar contacts, no photos, no vCard import/export

com.palm.app.email.note: Sample IMAP account; no mail server: sending moves the email to Sent, syncing finds nothing new. Phone: folders, list and message one at a time

org.webosphoenix.settings.note: Phoenix Settings (React, apps/settings); its launch points org.webosphoenix.settings.* share this entry

org.webosphoenix.phone.note: Phoenix Phone (React, apps/phone); tools/test-phone-messaging.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.messaging.note: Phoenix Messaging (React, apps/messaging); tools/test-phone-messaging.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.camera.note: Phoenix Camera (React, apps/camera); without a camera it shows its "No camera found" state. tools/test-media.cjs drives it with Chromium's fake camera

org.webosphoenix.photos.note: Phoenix Photos (React, apps/photos); tools/test-media.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.music.note: Phoenix Music (React, apps/music); tools/test-media.cjs drives it

com.palm.launcher.note: Just Type (luna-applauncher), shown by the shell over the cards. No remote (GAL) contact search or search suggestions offline

com.palm.app.browser.note: Pages show in a native Chromium view in phoenix-sim; elsewhere in an iframe (sites that refuse framing stay blank). No downloads, printing or page thumbnails. Phone: the address field has its own toolbar row

org.webosphoenix.files.note: Phoenix Files (React, apps/files); tools/test-files.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.tasks.note: Phoenix Tasks (React, apps/tasks); tools/test-tasks.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.voicememos.note: Phoenix Voice Memos (React, apps/voicememos); tools/test-voicememos.cjs drives it with Chromium's fake microphone. The simulator transcribes only the demo memos (whisper.cpp runs on the device)

org.webosphoenix.clipboard.note: Phoenix Clipboard (React, apps/clipboard) on the simulated org.webosphoenix.clipboard; tools/test-clipboard.cjs drives it and Settings > Clipboard

org.webosphoenix.assistant.note: Assistant (React, apps/assistant) on the simulated org.webosphoenix.assistant (apps/assistant/service in the page); tools/test-assistant.cjs drives it and Settings > Assistant

org.webosphoenix.flashlight.note: Phoenix Flashlight (React, apps/flashlight) on the simulated org.webosports.service.torch (LuneOS torchd's API); tools/test-flashlight.cjs drives it. The simulated LED lights nothing

org.webosphoenix.scanner.note: Phoenix QR Scanner (React, apps/scanner, zxing-wasm); tools/test-scanner.cjs drives it with Chromium's fake camera playing generated codes. Here without a camera it says so

org.webosphoenix.weather.note: Phoenix Weather (React, apps/weather) on Open-Meteo, location from the simulated com.webos.service.location; tools/test-weather.cjs drives it with recorded replies. Needs the network for live forecasts

org.webosphoenix.maps.note: Phoenix Maps (React, apps/maps); tools/test-maps.cjs drives it with the demo region (downtown San Jose) and stand-in search and routing servers. phoenix-sim's WebEngine has no WebGL 2 under Xvfb, so there it draws with the canvas renderer

org.webosphoenix.passwords.note: Phoenix Passwords (React, apps/passwords), a KeePass (KDBX 4) password manager; tools/test-passwords.cjs drives it. No key files or autofill yet

org.webosphoenix.authenticator.note: Phoenix Authenticator (React, apps/authenticator), TOTP/HOTP codes encrypted with the device passcode; starts on the 'set a device passcode' screen when there is none. tools/test-authenticator.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.terminal.note: Phoenix Terminal (React + xterm.js, apps/terminal) on org.webosphoenix.pty (services/pty). phoenix-sim runs a real shell on the host; in a browser tools/serve-rootfs.py --terminal does, else a small simulated shell. tools/test-terminal.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.videos.note: Phoenix Videos (React, apps/videos); tools/test-videos.cjs drives it with the demo videos (WebM, with WebVTT and SRT subtitles)

org.webosphoenix.podcasts.note: Phoenix Podcasts (React, apps/podcasts); starts with no subscriptions. tools/test-podcasts.cjs drives it against a local feed server; in phoenix-sim only feeds that send CORS headers can be fetched

org.webosphoenix.pdfview.note: Phoenix PDF View (React on PDF.js, apps/pdfview); tools/test-docs.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.docview.note: Phoenix Doc View (React, apps/docview): EPUB, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown and text, read-only; tools/test-docs.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.dav.note: Hidden: the CardDAV & CalDAV account's sign-in page and service (apps/dav); its main page only points to Accounts. tools/test-dav-sync.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.sharesheet.note: The share sheet is never launched by itself: the sweep opens it over Help with a link and text to share (org.webosphoenix.share/open), as any app does. tools/test-screenshot.cjs and tools/test-sharing.cjs use it

org.webosphoenix.help.note: Phoenix Help (React, apps/help): topics in Markdown (apps/help/topics), searchable, found by Just Type; tools/test-help.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.firstuse.note: Hidden: Phoenix First Use (React, apps/firstuse), run by the shell at first start and from Settings > Device Info; tools/test-firstuse.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.enactnotes.limestone.note: Temporary Enact demo (Limestone theme), laid out for tablets: at phone size it starts but its columns do not fit. tools/test-enact-notes.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.enactnotes.agate.note: Temporary Enact demo (Agate theme), laid out for tablets: at phone size it starts but its columns do not fit. tools/test-enact-notes.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.ionicnotes.note: 2.0 framework demo (Ionic 9, React), for phones and tablets; the same notes as the Enact demos. tools/test-ionic-notes.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.flutternotes.note: 2.0 framework demo (Flutter 3.47 web build, CanvasKit), for phones and tablets; the same notes as the other demos. Built only where Flutter is installed. tools/test-flutter-notes.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.marketplace.note: Phoenix Marketplace (React, apps/marketplace); tools/test-marketplace.cjs drives it against the catalog service

org.webosphoenix.notificationlab.note: Phoenix Notification Lab (React, apps/notificationlab): live activities, banners, dashboards, alerts and background tasks to review the notification area; tools/test-notificationlab.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.screenshot.note: the screen capture preview; without a capture it says how to take one

org.webosphoenix.agenda.note: Phoenix Agenda (React, apps/agenda), the dock mode exhibition of the calendar's coming days (com.palm.app.agendaview's place); not in the launcher. tools/test-exhibition.cjs drives it

org.webosphoenix.printmanager.note: Phoenix Print Manager (React, apps/printmanager; com.palm.app.printmanager): the jobs and printers of com.palm.printmgr, whose only printer in the simulator is Save as PDF; tools/test-browser.cjs prints to it

org.webosphoenix.voicedial.note: Phoenix Voice Dial (React, apps/voicedial; com.palm.sysapp.voicedial): listens through the shell's dictation (org.webosphoenix.dictation); in a browser without the shell it says it needs the microphone. tools/test-voicedial.cjs drives it

com.palm.systemui.note: luna-systemui as the shell's headless page: alerts, dashboards and banners (its services now see com.palm.bus registerServerStatus answer). Tested with the mail account signed out, so it opens its Accounts: Action Needed dashboard

org.webosphoenix.dropshare.note: Phoenix DropShare (React, apps/dropshare): off until allowed (Settings > DropShare); a page has no server of its own, phoenix-sim runs it (shell/sim/simdropshare.h). tools/test-sharing.cjs drives it against a fake server, build/simnet-test the real one
